newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: South Africa's Old Mutual warns of volatile rand.
newsitem.headline: South Africa's Old Mutual warns of volatile rand.

text.p: South Africa's rand looks set for a roller-coaster ride in the next 12 months and could well move down again, due to exchnage control concessions, Old Mutual Unit Trusts' economist Erika Prinsloo said on Thursday.
The government plans to relax many exchange controls on private individuals from July 1.
Prinsloo also said that the current surge of international money into South African markets could reverse at any time.
"Hot money flows are notoriously fickle and further rises in U.S. interest rates could lead to rapid changes in sentiment," she said in a statement.
She pointed out that a weaker rand would be positive for growth and the government appeared keen not to let the currency appreciate too far.
